84: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<UtilityClass> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
85: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE, "@UtilityClass");
86: 		
87: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, UtilityClass.class);
88: 		
89: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
90: 		if (!checkLegality(typeNode, annotationNode)) return;
91: 		changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);

94: 	private static boolean checkLegality(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
95: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
96: 			errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass is only supported on a class.");
97: 			return false;
98: 		}
99: 		
100: 		// It might be an inner class. This is okay, but only if it is / can be a static inner class. Thus, all of its parents have to be static inner classes until the top-level.
101: 		JavacNode typeWalk = typeNode;
102: 		while (true) {
103: 			typeWalk = typeWalk.up();
104: 			switch (typeWalk.getKind()) {
105: 			case TYPE:
106: 				JCClassDecl typeDef = (JCClassDecl) typeWalk.get();
107: 				if ((typeDef.mods.flags & (Flags.STATIC | Flags.ANNOTATION | Flags.ENUM | Flags.INTERFACE)) != 0) continue;
108: 				if (typeWalk.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return true;
109: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass automatically makes the class static, however, this class cannot be made static.");
110: 				return false;
111: 			case COMPILATION_UNIT:
112: 				return true;
113: 			default:
114: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass cannot be placed on a method local or anonymous inner class, or any class nested in such a class.");
115: 				return false;
116: 			}
117: 		}
118: 	}

120: 	private void changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
121: 		JCClassDecl classDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
122: 		
123: 		boolean makeConstructor = true;
124: 		
125: 		classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.FINAL;
126: 		
127: 		boolean markStatic = true;
128: 		
129: 		if (typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) markStatic = false;
130: 		if (markStatic && typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
131: 			JCClassDecl typeDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.up().get();
132: 			if ((typeDecl.mods.flags & (Flags.INTERFACE | Flags.ANNOTATION)) != 0) markStatic = false;
133: 		}
134: 		
135: 		if (markStatic) classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
136: 		
137: 		for (JavacNode element : typeNode.down()) {
138: 			if (element.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
139: 				JCVariableDecl fieldDecl = (JCVariableDecl) element.get();
140: 				fieldDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
141: 			} else if (element.getKind() == Kind.METHOD) {

143: 				if (methodDecl.name.contentEquals("<init>")) {
144: 					if (getGeneratedBy(methodDecl) == null && (methodDecl.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) == 0) {

148: 					}

152: 			} else if (element.getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
153: 				JCClassDecl innerClassDecl = (JCClassDecl) element.get();

Fixed. The root cause: when `@UtilityClass` marks an inner class static, its `ClassSymbol` kept a stale `erasure_field` (computed for the non-static, generic enclosing type), which made javac's inference crash with an NPE in `Types.asSuper`.

Changes (mirrors upstream fix for #3326):
- `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleUtilityClass.java:155` — after `setEnclosingType(Type.noType)`, also reset `innerClassSymbol.erasure_field = null`.
- `src/stubs/com/sun/tools/javac/code/Symbol.java:28` — added the `erasure_field` stub field lombok compiles against.

Verified with `ant test.instance` in the container: all 384 tests pass, including `javac-UtilityClassGeneric.java` (the reproduction case) and all previously passing UtilityClass tests.
